zones.name: Lantern Library
zones.story: Weathered books, reading tables and a vaulted ceiling. The northern doorway rejoins the winding ward.

zones.name: Ember Hall
zones.story: A sheltered forge, stores and the wardens’ planning table. Two doors lead back into the maze.

zones.name: Mossheart Cloister
zones.story: A memorial garden sheltered by old stone. Ivy returns when the curse is lifted.

zones.name: Provisioners’ Court
zones.story: The market stores tell the story of the castle’s last long winter.

zones.name: Banner Court
zones.story: A broad meeting court where the watch once assembled.

zones.name: The Lantern Gate
zones.story: Enter the ward below, or take the broad stair beside the gate to the battlements.

zones.name: The High Watch
zones.story: The curtain walls are a complete walking loop. Two roof galleries lead inward toward the keep.

zones.name: The Crystal Keep
zones.story: The corruption crystal remains below the throne. Stairs turn up through the keep to the roof.

zones.name: The Wardens’ Galleries
zones.story: Raised stone bridges connect the halls, battlements and keep. Look down to read the maze beneath you.

zones.name: The Crown Walk
zones.story: The castle’s highest walk looks back over every district. Gargoyles still haunt the old perches.

relics.name: The Keeper’s Ledger
relics.story: The ward was built as a refuge. Its roof galleries still connect the keep to both great halls.

relics.name: The Warden’s Mark
relics.story: The smiths marked every repaired gate. Search above the keep for the watch captain’s last seal.

relics.name: The Watch Captain’s Seal
relics.story: From the highest watch, three records make a history: the library, the forge and this final lookout.
